items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I had another fellow by the name of Lewis Horace. He used to play trumpet too.

ctx.x: So it was going and organized and everything.
Yeah. It was set up when I was a little boy. I had another fellow by the name of Lewis Horace. He used to play trumpet too. Mm-hmm.
What about Joe Adrian? Did he ever play out that much?
